holds.title: Lifted: destination purchase decisions corrected (D15)
holds.reason: The destination pointer, indeterminate-read and single-node transfer regressions pass. Empty exports, the converged freeze, real-store and DEC-16 prerequisites remain binding before any live wiring.

lines.what: attachHashAndVerify replaces an unobserved reported hash (A to B) while A's read may still be in flight
recordUnverified writes a stale hash's non-included read over the stored observation
verifySettlement captures the retained pointer before its asynchronous reads
the durable nonce-consumption record is written with the captured hash
the settlement transaction records the observation and moves the purchase to settled_verified without comparing the retained pointer with the captured hash
observe updates the observation with no condition on the reported hash

holds.rule: Step 1 freezes the entire package: no file may be added, removed or changed, and package.json retains exports: {} with no main or bin. Step 1 also freezes every repository file outside the package at its Git blob at the pinned work head (step1Freeze.outside): no outside file may be added, removed or changed, whatever it contains. A literal dacs-client outside the package is also refused, as a tripwire only; the root lockfile's workspace registration is its one exception. HOLD.json and check-hold.mjs are the reviewed control pair, changed together in the same commit for any pin update or hold lift. No delta wires verifyDeal, attachHashAndVerify, verifySettlement, PurchaseStore or WalletActions to a live wallet or chain until D15 closes pointer-retention's race and the listed regressions pass. D1's import cuts alone do not lift the hold. The client package plan carries pointer-retention's fence and the source change's correction into the moved code as reviewed D15 delta commits on the destination head; no supplied source head carries the fence. For every frozen path, the index and working file must match HEAD in path, blob bytes and regular-file mode; HEAD blobs must match the freeze pins. The gate reads HEAD and index object identities directly, hashes working files, and refuses symlinks, gitlinks, unresolved index entries and a missing HEAD. D11 remains a binding prerequisite after an isolated D15 hold lift: it must provide the transaction contract and pass the destination regressions against its real store before any live wiring. Purchase actions additionally remain unconditionally held until a coordinated Standard release and trusted session/participant profile admission are implemented; no caller profile record lifts this hold.

liftRequires.sourceFix: A reviewed D15 delta commit in this package, with the listed regressions passing on the reviewed destination head, carrying pointer-retention's fence and the source change's inspected correction as the client package plan requires. A supplied, reviewed source fix copied with provenance is also acceptable; no supplied head carries pointer-retention's fence.

regressions.case: A delayed observation of hash A after the retained pointer changes to B cannot verify B, in both completion orders: A's read completes after B is reported, and B's verification completes before A's read.

A stale read of A, included or not, cannot overwrite an existing observation of B (wallet-transactions.mjs:114 through recordUnverified, purchases.mjs:789), and the durable nonce-consumption record is not written with A's hash (purchases.mjs:905).
A stale read of A cannot consume B's lane or supersede another purchase.
The same cases hold across a restart between the hash change and A's completion.
Pre-authentication seller-pointer failures and all unmarked read errors stay indeterminate; a malformed seller pointer cannot change purchase status and keeps a separate diagnostic.
Unmarked Agreement read and recheck errors carry no authentication mark through the payment gate and keep verified delivery; marked contradictions alone can lower it.
A late unverified read of the same retained hash cannot change a recorded verification or terminal decision, including settled_verified, payment_mismatch and superseded.
A competing native lane saves its resolution marker using its own retained pointer; stale owner/pointer checks or refused writes remain unresolved, and retry plus restart keep the saved marker.

A fresh single-node transfer response that differs in transaction, block, payer, payee, amount or time stays indeterminate on first read and preserves retained delivery on recheck. Authenticated evidence contradictions still reject.

liftRequires.condition: Every regression above passes against the reviewed destination head carrying D15's delta commit in this package (or a reviewed source fix copied with provenance).
liftRequires.probeResult: The committed probe loads http-mcp from DACS_FRONTEND_REPO at a source commit; it never loads this package, and without that variable it skips both tests and exits 0. D15 must retarget it at this package's moved modules, or add equivalent package tests after D1. The lift requires # tests 2 and # pass 2 on the reviewed fixed destination head (or fixed source), not exit 0. At 82bf8c4 both fail. A pass is necessary, not sufficient: the other listed regressions must pass too. Destination delta record: 119/119 isolated destination cases pass: purchase-integrity 12, buyer-chain-indeterminate 4, commitment classifiers 17, review races 10, review decisions 63, native stage help 13. Original reviewer probes pass 3/3. Historical review baseline c55c2d9: races 0/10, decisions 6/42, stage help 1/10; only the already-deleted fixture continuation reference was removed in scratch to permit coordinator construction. Original pre-D15 baseline replay at rebased D1 head 0fad6e8: 0/33. Compact TAP evidence is retained in evidence/review-*.txt; D11 must rerun the store-dependent cases against its real adapter. An earlier review: six fresh transfer tuple fields stay indeterminate on first read and preserve delivered state on recheck; readback-review-decisions registers 63 tests and all pass. Reviewer transfer probe registers two and both pass.

outside.what: Every tracked file outside packages/dacs-client/ at the frozen work head, with its Git blob. The gate lists tracked files (tracked ignored output included) and unignored untracked files, and fails on any added, removed or changed outside file, whatever it contains. Untracked files Git ignores are unseen: they belong to no commit, so they cannot reach review or a merge. For every frozen path, the index and working file must match HEAD in path, blob bytes and regular-file mode; HEAD blobs must match the freeze pins. The gate reads HEAD and index object identities directly, hashes working files, and refuses symlinks, gitlinks, unresolved index entries and a missing HEAD.

literalNameTripwire.what: Extra check only: a literal dacs-client in an outside path or file fails. It does not see computed, escaped or encoded spellings; the outside inventory is what holds the outside rule.

package-lock.json.reason: Existing workspace registration only: four references, required by npm ci. Its bytes are pinned in the outside inventory like every other outside file.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.reason: Runs only the frozen private client regression gate; no runtime import, export or live adapter is wired. Exact workflow blob remains pinned in the outside inventory.

plannedRepins.what: The outside inventory fails closed on any other repository change, including planned work that is not a client consumer. Each change below needs its own visible re-pin commit that updates HOLD.json and check-hold.mjs together; review checks that the re-pinned inventory differs from the previous one only by that change.

changes.what: Any package-lock.json change (a new workspace or a dependency update). The lockfile stays an exact blob pin; it is not checked structurally in step 1.
The WS-3 seller step-1 merge (packages/dacs-seller/ and its lockfile entries).
Any rebase of work onto a newer main.
Each client-delta-series commit, including the D15 lift and later record corrections; the package freeze remains in force with exports empty.

plannedRepins.mergePolicy: Step 1 never merges alone: the client-delta-series series adds D15's fence and its listed regressions before any client code is callable. The freeze remains in force after the purchase hold is lifted; callable package exports and live wiring still require their recorded prerequisites and reviewed deltas.
